correctness.rationale: The rank-one ansatz is general by nondegenerate trace duality. Coefficient comparison forces B²=λB and CB=uC, BC=vC with u+v=λ. Square-zero and idempotent cases exhaust all solutions in all characteristics. The Gaussian-binomial counts include their precise scaling redundancies, and direct finite-field tests independently check the defining identity. The large-q dominant degree is checked separately. The proof is finite-dimensional and does not infer infinity from enumeration.

value.rationale: The rank-one stratum is the first nonzero natural stratum of RB operator varieties. The theorem supplies an all-characteristic geometric classification for all matrix sizes and a closed finite-field point census by image-matrix rank, not a narrow arbitrary slice. The leading finite-field mass changes from idempotent image lines in dimension two to square-zero image lines for every n>=3; this is a substantive structural distinction potentially useful for studying higher operator-rank strata.
